integrity: The infinite theorem is proved by an exact structural decomposition. Finite exhaustive computation through order 10 is only a verification stress test. Literature searches and full-text comparisons were used to separate the all-function enumerator from prior scalar optimization results.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is for ordinary Roman {2}-dominating functions on connected complete multipartite graphs. Known scalar minimum results for complete bipartite graphs are prior work. An earlier month-only December 2015 record exists for the foundational article, but no exact calendar day for that earlier record was verified; no day was invented.
title: Weight enumerator of all Roman \(\{2\}\)-dominating functions on complete multipartite graphs
